rejected_rule.statement: The Bank must comply with the mandatory provisions of Section 71(4) of the Finance Act No. 11 of 1963, as amended, which requires the Bank to notify the owner of the premises of its determination to acquire the premises and to cause a notice to be delivered or transmitted to the proper Registrar of Lands for registration.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Where the Bank has determined that any premises shall be acquired for the purposes of this Part of this Act, the Bank shall- (a) Notify such determination to the owner of such premises; and (b) Cause a notice to be delivered or transmitted to the proper Registrar of Lands for registration, setting out the prescribed particulars relating to those premises and stating that those premises are to be acquired under this Part of this Act.
